d:
The Magic defeated the Raptors, 121-114 tonight in Toronto. Desmond Bane contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 6 assists 6 three pointers and 2 rebounds, with Franz Wagner of the Magic adding an additional 26 points (8-18 FG, 2-7 3P) in the game. Scottie Barnes finished with a team-high 41 points along with 5 rebounds for the Raptors in the losing effort. The Magic improve their record to 2-3 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 3-2 for the season.
